title_sq: Ne Bllok, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Perfekt Per Investim!!
description_sq: Ne Bllok, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Perfekt Per Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje pallati 6-katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes me dalje ne ballkon, gatimi i vecuar, dy dhomat e gjumit, dhoma matrimoniale ne tualet te dedikuar dhe me dalje ne ballkon, nje tualet tjeter dhe nje depo. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar dhe me te gjitha paisjet elektroshtepiake funksionale, si dhe i pajisur me kondicioner. Apartamenti ka nje lokacion perfekt per banim ose per investim pasi ndodhet ne nje nder zonat me te preferuara te Tiranes. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In the block, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, perfect for investment!!
description_en: In the block, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, perfect for investment!!! The apartment is located on the second floor of a well-managed 6-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with access to the balcony, a separate kitchen, two bedrooms, a matrimonial room with a dedicated toilet and access to the balcony, another toilet and a storage room. The apartment is fully furnished and with all functional appliances, as well as equipped with air conditioning. The apartment has a perfect location for residence or investment as it is located in one of the most popular areas of Tirana. The property has full mortgage documentation.
